name: gmail_send
description: Sends a new message from the user's Gmail, optionally attaching one file from the workspace; the recipients get it at once. Use it only after showing the user the recipient, subject, exact text (and the file, if any) and getting a yes. To answer a message the user received, use gmail_reply instead, so it stays in its conversation. If the same subject already went to the same person in the last hour it is not sent again; never call it twice. Returns one line confirming the send.

to.description: Recipient address, or several separated by commas (e.g. clara@example.com).

subject.description: The subject the user approved (e.g. "Quote for the logo").

message.description: The exact text the user approved, with nothing added.

attachment.description: Full path of one file to attach, inside the workspace (e.g. a file gmail_read saved). Leave it out for no attachment.

account.description: Address of the mailbox to use, when this assistant has more than one (e.g. someone@example.com). Leave it out to use the only one.

examples.subject: Quote for the logo
examples.message: Hi Clara, here is the quote.
